# FontHeight <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Fonts and Text](BlitzBasic-Fonts-and-Text)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FontHeight:Int32
```

**Returns:** The height of a character in pixels.

## Description

The height in pixels of a character of the current font, as set by [SetFont](SetFont). Use it to place lines of text below each other.

## Differences

* The height is the height that was requested, as with Windows fonts. For a font that is not found, the built-in bitmap font is used, where [FontWidth](FontWidth) is the same number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Local small = LoadFont("Arial", 8)
Local big = LoadFont("Arial", 24)
SetFont small
Text 10, 10, "Small: " + FontWidth() + " x " + FontHeight()
SetFont big
Text 10, 40, "Big: " + FontWidth() + " x " + FontHeight()
Flip
WaitKey
```
